_comment: Rules for a Japanese-standard apartment-building drawing (layers like 1F-F_FINI1-100, door blocks SD-/SUD-/AD-, room schedule in ROOM block attributes). Layer meanings were inferred from the drawing's geometry, not from a published standard: F_FINI = wall/room finish outlines (drawn as double lines, use wall_representation=double_line); F_FITT1 = fittings (AW- windows are NOT doors); ROOM blocks carry [id, name, area m2, finishes...]. Use with include_blocks=1F-BLOCK_100 to read one floor at the 1:100 scale only.
